name: Gene Munster
zh_summary: @munster_gene: $AAPL got test approval for AI powered Siri in China, a big step he expected mid 2027; he guesses general availability in 1H 2027, noting Tesla's FSD testing approval in China a year ago has not progressed.
en_summary: @munster_gene: $AAPL got test approval for AI powered Siri in China, a big step he expected mid 2027; he guesses general availability in 1H 2027, noting Tesla's FSD testing approval in China a year ago has not progressed.
text:
$AAPL gets test approval for AI powered Siri in China.  This is a big step forward.  I expected this milestone mid 2027.  

Now the question is when will it move from testing to general availability.  My guess is the first half of 2027. 

Keep in mind, testing doesn’t mean general availability. Just over a year ago, Tesla got “approval for testing” on FSD in China, and so far it’s been crickets on that front

name: Peter Schiff

en_summary: @PeterSchiff: Sept PPI rose 1.3%, almost triple estimates, annualizing to nearly 17%; YoY 6.3%; core +0.7%, nearly 9% annualized. PPI leads CPI, and despite hikes real rates are plunging.
text: Producer prices skyrocketed 1.3% in Sept., almost triple estimates. That annualizes to an inflation rate of nearly 17%! YoY PPI rose 6.3%. Sept. core rose 0.7%. That annualizes to nearly 9% inflation. PPI is a leading indicator of CPI. Despite rate hikes, real rates are plunging.
